 Follow Vitória de Guimarães vs FC Porto live score, confirmed lineups, match stats & standings in Primeira Liga (Liga Portugal) on VAVEL.
 Coverage by Caio Lopes Patricio Updated November 8, 2026, 2:30 pm ET ADVERTISEMENT
 Live Last update 2:30 PM ET 67' 2:30 PM ET 4 minutes ago Yellow Card for Porto!
 Yellow Card for Porto! Hwang In-Beom receives a yellow card in the 67th minute after fouling Tony Strata. The Vitória de Guimarães player wins a foul in the defensive half, and Porto now has another player cautioned in the match.
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 Key moments
 2:30 PM ET 67' Yellow card · Porto 
 2:01 PM ET Tactical adjustments and bench options for the… 
 1:50 PM ET 46' End of the first half at the Estádio D 
 1:47 PM ET 43' Yellow card · Porto 
 1:42 PM ET 39' Goal · Porto 0-1 
 1:39 PM ET 34' Yellow card · Vitória Guimarães 
 1:30 PM ET 26' Porto's goal disallowed! 
 Follow VAVEL on Google 66' 2:28 PM ET 6 minutes ago Porto makes two more substitutions in the 66th minute
 Porto makes two more substitutions in the 66th minute. Hwang In-Beom comes on for Gabri Veiga, while Nehuén Pérez replaces Jan Bednarek, who had to leave the field after undergoing concussion protocol. The Portuguese team makes its final changes to maintain its lead.
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 64' 2:25 PM ET 9 minutes ago The match is temporarily interrupted for treatment of Jan Bednarek
 The match is temporarily interrupted for treatment of Jan Bednarek, from Porto, who is experiencing pain and receiving medical assistance. In the 64th minute, Vitória de Guimarães also makes its first substitution: Alan comes on for Samu.
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 59' 2:22 PM ET 12 minutes ago Porto makes three substitutions
 Porto makes three substitutions. Martim Fernandes comes on for Borja Sainz, Alan Varela replaces Pablo Rosario, and André Silva takes Samu Aghehowa's place. Francesco Farioli seeks to renew the team's energy to maintain control of the match.
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 57' 2:21 PM ET 13 minutes ago Another good attack from Vitória Guimarães!
 Another good attack from Vitória Guimarães! Beni Mukendi played a beautiful through ball to striker Arnel Jakupovic, who shot with his left foot across goal; goalkeeper Diogo Costa made the save and prevented the equalizing goal.
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 56' 2:20 PM ET 13 minutes ago 57': Vitória Guimarães hits the post!
 Vitória Guimarães hits the post! Full-back Ahmed Sidibe carried the ball forward and shot from outside the area; the ball hit the crossbar and bounced back. Porto's defense got the rebound and started the play.
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 55' 2:16 PM ET 18 minutes ago Vitória de Guimarães is trying to push forward and maintain a stronger
 Vitória de Guimarães is trying to push forward and maintain a stronger presence in the attacking third, but is finding it difficult to create chances due to technical errors and inaccurate passes. Meanwhile, Porto continues to look for spaces to extend their lead, but struggles to deliver the final pass and convert possession into clear goal-scoring opportunities.
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 50' 2:11 PM ET 22 minutes ago Porto maintains control of the match at the start of the second half
 Porto maintains control of the match at the start of the second half, keeping possession and working their passing game to find openings in the opposing defense. Vitória de Guimarães, on the other hand, adopts a more defensive posture, prioritizing defensive organization and trying to disrupt Porto's attacks.
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 45' 2:06 PM ET 27 minutes ago The ball is rolling again at the Estádio D
 The ball is rolling again at the Estádio D. Afonso Henriques! Vitória de Guimarães and Porto begin the second half, with the Dragons leading 1-0 thanks to a good scored by Borja Sainz in the first half. The home team is looking to react and equalize, while the visitors are trying to extend their lead and secure another victory in the Primeira Liga.
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 2:01 PM ET 33 minutes ago Tactical adjustments and bench options for the second half
 Vitória de Guimarães needs cleaner ball circulation in the second half after completing just 66% of 109 passes, making Alan or Miguel Nogueira strong options off the bench. Meanwhile, Porto dictated the tempo with 185 passes at 82% accuracy, though the Dragons were caught offside seven times and have Santiago Gimenez ready for the box.
 Completed passes (accuracy): Vitória de Guimarães 109 (66%) – 185 (82%) Porto
 Fouls committed: Vitória de Guimarães 7 – 4 Porto
 Yellow cards: Vitória de Guimarães 2 – 2 Porto
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 1:55 PM ET 39 minutes ago First-half stats: Vitória de Guimarães 0-1 Porto
 Porto controlled the opening 45 minutes with 58% possession and 185 passes, finding the breakthrough in the 38th minute when Borja Sainz finished inside the box for the 0-1 lead. The Dragons registered 6 total shots and 2 shots on target, while Vitória de Guimarães had 5 shots and 1 shot on target.
 Ball possession: Vitória de Guimarães 42% – 58% Porto
 Total shots (on target): Vitória de Guimarães 5 (1) – 6 (2) Porto
 Corners: Vitória de Guimarães 0 – 1 Porto
 Goalkeeper saves: Vitória de Guimarães 1 – 1 Porto
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 46' 1:50 PM ET 44 minutes ago End of the first half at the Estádio D
 End of the first half at the Estádio D. Afonso Henriques! Porto is winning against Vitória de Guimarães 1-0, with a good scored by Borja Sainz. The Dragons were superior for much of the first half and managed to turn their dominance into a lead on the scoreboard.
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 43' 1:47 PM ET an hour ago Yellow card for Porto!
 Yellow card for Porto! Gonçalo Nogueira was dribbling through the middle when midfielder Pablo Rosário made a strong tackle. The referee awarded a free kick and showed a yellow card to the midfielder, who protested vehemently.
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 39' 1:42 PM ET an hour ago Goal for Porto!
 Goal for Porto! Bednareck delivered a great pass down the right flank to Alberto Costa, the full-back surged forward and sent in a low cross to the far post for Borja Sainz, who finished into the back of the net to open the scoring.
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 34' 1:39 PM ET an hour ago Yellow card for Vitória Guimarães!
 Yellow card for Vitória Guimarães! João Mendes made a strong challenge on winger Pepê, and the referee showed a yellow card to the Vitória full-back. Forward Arnel Jakupovic also received a yellow card for excessive arguing with the referee.
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 31' 1:34 PM ET an hour ago Midfielder Pablo Rosario felt pain in his leg after attempting a cross
 Midfielder Pablo Rosario felt pain in his leg after attempting a cross and had to leave the field to receive medical attention. The player remains off the field while he is evaluated by Porto's medical team.
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 26' 1:30 PM ET an hour ago Porto's goal disallowed!
 Porto's goal disallowed! Pepê played a through ball to Alberto Costa, the full-back crossed low to Borja Sainz, who shot towards goal, the goalkeeper parried the ball to Samu, who arrived and opened the scoring. But the linesman flagged Alberto offside at the start of the play.
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 22' 1:25 PM ET an hour ago Porto grew into the game and delivered a superior performance
 Porto grew into the game and delivered a superior performance, managing to control the action more and create the main goal-scoring opportunities. The Dragons found spaces in the opposing defense and posed a threat in attack, while Vitória de Guimarães struggled to build attacks from the back and create their offensive plays.
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 16' 1:19 PM ET an hour ago Great chance for Porto!
 Great chance for Porto! The ball fell to Pepê, the Brazilian striker shot from outside the box, goalkeeper Lucas Furtado parried it into the middle of the area and on the rebound Gabri Veiga appeared unmarked, but ended up wasting the chance and shot wide.
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 12' 1:15 PM ET an hour ago Porto's first chance!
 Porto's first chance! Midfielder Borja Sainz controlled the ball at the edge of the box, adjusted his position and shot with his right foot; the ball went just wide and out for a good kick for Vitória de Guimarães.
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 10' 1:13 PM ET an hour ago The match remains balanced, with both teams looking for spaces to attack
 The match remains balanced, with both teams looking for spaces to attack. Porto is trying to take control of the game, maintaining possession and working the passing game to find opportunities, while Vitória de Guimarães is looking to organize defensively and exploit the spaces left by their opponent.
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 5' 1:08 PM ET an hour ago The match starts with a lot of action
 The match starts with a lot of action, with both teams looking for goals and spaces to build their attacking plays. Vitória de Guimarães is more present in the attacking third and relies mainly on aerial balls to threaten the opposing defense. Porto, on the other hand, seeks to exploit quick transitions, using the speed of its players to surprise the home team.
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 0' 1:03 PM ET 2 hours ago The ball is rolling at the Estádio D
 The ball is rolling at the Estádio D. Afonso Henriques! Vitória de Guimarães and Porto face off in the 11th round of the Portuguese Primeira Liga. The home team seeks to surprise the league leaders, while the Dragons try to maintain their 100% record in the championship.
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 1:02 PM ET 2 hours ago Importance of victory for Porto
 Porto enters the field seeking to maintain its 100% record in the Primeira Liga and extend its lead at the top. With 30 points earned in ten rounds, the Dragons have a five-point lead over second place and are trying to achieve their 11th consecutive victory in the championship.
 In addition to defending their unbeaten record, the team led by Francesco Farioli intends to take advantage of the good moment after the thrashing of Napoli in the Champions League to maintain confidence and consolidate its position at the top of the table. Another triumph would also represent another step in the pursuit of the Portuguese title.
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 12:50 PM ET 2 hours ago Importance of victory for Vitória de Guimarães
 Vitória de Guimarães sees the match as an opportunity to achieve an important result against the league leaders. In 13th place, with nine points, the Conquistadores seek to gain points to improve their position in the table and move away from the bottom of the standings.
 The team led by Luís Pinto also intends to take advantage of the home advantage and the support of the fans to try to end the streak of eight consecutive defeats against Porto at the Estádio D. Afonso Henriques. A victory would have an even greater significance, as it would be the first team to take points from the Dragons in this edition of the Primeira Liga.
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 12:45 PM ET 2 hours ago Francesco Farioli – Porto Coach
 Maintaining the momentum.
 “It’s a mix of several things. We have to bring some aspects from the last two games, but the past is the past. FC Porto’s mentality is very clear: we have to win the next game. That’s what we want to do tomorrow. What we did belongs to the past, it was a special and important moment, but we are focused on the next game.”
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 12:43 PM ET 2 hours ago Luís Pinto – Vitória de Guimarães Coach
 Opportunity to end the unbeaten run.
 “We go into the game with the objective, with the challenge and with the hope of obviously being the first team to take points from FC Porto. We will go in exclusively thinking about winning. For that, we have to be very inspired and FC Porto also have a not-so-good day.”
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 12:35 PM ET 2 hours ago Refereeing
 The refereeing will be led by David Silva (POR), assisted by Carlos Campos (POR) and Nelson Cunha (POR). The fourth official will be Vítor Ferreira (POR), while Luís Ferreira (POR) will be responsible for VAR.
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 12:34 PM ET 2 hours ago Porto's reserves
 These are the substitute players for the Porto team for this match:
 Cláudio Ramos; Martim Fernandes, Nehuén Pérez, Dominik Prpić, Francisco Moura, Souza, Alan Varela, Seko Fofana, Inbeom Hwang, Oskar Pietuszewski, Santiago Gimenez and André Silva.
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 12:29 PM ET 2 hours ago Vitória de Guimarães Substitutes
 The substitute players for the Vitória de Guimarães team for this match are as follows:
 Oliwier Zych, Miguel Maga, Oscar Rivas, Matija Mitrović, Alan Guimarães, Miguel Nogueira, Victor Andersson, Alioune Ndoye, Thiago Balieiro, Patrick Ouotro, Mohammed Kebdani and Lohann Doucet
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 12:28 PM ET 2 hours ago Porto's Lineup
 The Porto lineup has been released; The Dragons will field this team:
 Diogo Costa (C); Alberto Costa, Jan Bednarek, Jakub Kiwior, Zaidu Sanusi, Pablo Rosario, Victor Froholdt, Gabri Veiga, Borja Sainz, Pepê and Samu.
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 12:21 PM ET 2 hours ago Vitória de Guimarães Lineup
 The Vitória de Guimarães lineup has been released; The Conquistadores are fielding this team:
 Lucas Furtado, Ahmed Sidibe, Oumar Camara, Gonçalo Nogueira, Arnel Jakupović, Gustavo Silva, João Mendes, Beni Mukendi, Samu Silva © , Toni Borevković, Tony Strata.
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 12:21 PM ET 2 hours ago Key Player for Vitória de Guimarães
 Forward Arnel Jakupovic is one of Vitória de Guimarães' main offensive threats for the match. This season, the Austrian has scored two goals in the Primeira Liga and is looking to increase his tally against the league leaders.
 He should once again be Luís Pinto's main offensive option, especially given the team's difficulties in scoring goals. With only ten goals scored in ten rounds, Jakupovic will have the task of taking advantage of opportunities to try and surprise FC Porto.
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 12:21 PM ET 2 hours ago Key Player for FC Porto
 Gabri Veiga is one of FC Porto's main offensive highlights in the 2026/27 season. The midfielder has scored five goals in the Primeira Liga and is in good form, having scored and provided an assist in each of his last two matches.
 The Spaniard was again decisive in the 4-1 victory over Napoli in the Champions League and arrives in good form for the Portuguese Championship match. Alongside Borja Sainz, who also has five goals in the competition, Veiga represents one of Francesco Farioli's main offensive weapons.
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 12:17 PM ET 2 hours ago Head-to-head history
 Vitória de Guimarães and FC Porto have a recent history largely favorable to the Dragons. The visiting team has won the last eight competitive matches played at the Estádio D. Afonso Henriques, in addition to not conceding a goal in their three most recent visits to the stadium.
 This negative record represents an additional challenge for the Conquistadores, who are trying to take advantage of the home advantage to interrupt their opponents' winning streak.
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 11:45 AM ET 3 hours ago Match Stadium
 The Estádio D. Afonso Henriques, located in Guimarães, Portugal, is the home of Vitória de Guimarães. Inaugurated in 1965 and later remodeled to host matches of Euro 2004, the stadium has a capacity of approximately 30,000 spectators.
 Known for the atmosphere created by the Conquistadores fans, the stadium will host the match valid for the 11th round of the Portuguese Primeira Liga .

 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 10:00 AM ET 5 hours ago How Vitória de Guimarães is doing
 Vitória de Guimarães arrives for the match looking to continue its recovery this season. After achieving only one victory in the first eight Primeira Liga matches and accumulating five games without a win, the team has shown signs of improvement in recent rounds.
 The reaction began with a 1-0 victory over Recreativa de Lamelas in the Taça de Portugal, followed by a 5-0 thrashing of Marítimo. In the last round, the Conquistadores drew 0-0 with Gil Vicente , a result that extended their streak without conceding a goal to three consecutive matches.
 Currently in 13th place with nine points, Vitória has two wins, three draws, and five losses in the competition.e Portuguese Championship.
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 10:00 AM ET 5 hours ago How FC Porto is doing
 FC Porto arrives for the match in excellent form in the Primeira Liga. Under the command of Francesco Farioli, the Dragons have won all 30 points in the first ten rounds, establishing their best start to a championship since the 1939/40 season.
 The team also boasts impressive numbers in both attack and defense. With 25 goals scored, they have one of the best attacks in the competition, while the four goals conceded represent the best defense in the tournament, along with six clean sheets.
 In the last round of the Portuguese Championship, the Dragons thrashed Estoril Praia 4-0. Later, in the Champions League, they achieved an impressive 4-1 victory.ctory over Napoli, extending their winning streak in all competitions to four matches.
